name: Composer (php-actions)
description: Use the Composer CLI in your Github Actions.

version.description: What version of Composer to use

php_version.description: What version of PHP to use

php_extensions.description: Space separated list of extensions to configure with the PHP build

only_args.description: Only run the desired command with this args. Ignoring all other provided arguments

interaction.description: Whether to ask any interactive questions. Values: 'yes' or 'no'

dev.description: Whether to install dev packages. Values: 'yes' or 'no'

ssh_key.description: The private key contents to use for private repositories

ssh_key_pub.description: The public key contents to use for private repositories

ssh_domain.description: The domain to gather SSH public keys for (automatic for github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org)

ssh_port.description: Custom port to use in conjunction with ssh_domain

working_dir.description: Use the given directory as working directory

container_workdir.description: Sets the aplication workdir inside container
